name: Flamefall
storyline:
The Ancient Altars of Flame in the Dark Forest are being extinguished, plunging the land into darkness and awakening the horrors the fire kept at bay - they call it the Flamefall.

There used to be many but nowadays only a handful of people are graced with Ignis - the flame spirit. They become Ember Wardens and their mission is vital:
Reignite the altars, restore the light and uncover the mystery behind the Flamefall.
summary: In this pausable real time tactics horror game, you play as a team of four Ember Wardens who venture into the dark woods, searching for the Altar of Flame that you need to reignite. Exploring the darkness, fighting off creepy ambushing enemies and looting is all done with a unique combination of automatic and manual abilities that are gained through items found throughout the game.
